Stays within 7.x for @temporalio/proto compatibility; also clears GHSA-f38q-mgvj-vph7 (moderate, <=7.6.2). Remove once @temporalio/proto ships a patched protobufjs.
//overrides.jest-runtime: react-native@0.83.6's jest preset locks jest-environment-node@29.7.0 + jest-mock@29.7.0 (no clearMocksOnScope), which npm hoists to the root. jest-runtime 30.4.x calls _environment.moduleMocker.clearMocksOnScope() in resetModules() and 20/20 mobile suites fail. Pin to 30.3.0 (last release before that call was added) until either react-native ships a jest-30 preset or we add jest-environment-node/@jest/environment/@jest/fake-timers/jest-mock overrides for the mobile workspace.
//overrides.decompress: GHSA-mp2f-45pm-3cg9 (critical, archive path traversal). shellcheck depends on the abandoned `decompress` package directly (no patch was ever released — 4.2.1 is both latest and vulnerable). Aliased to the maintained @xhmikosr/decompress fork instead of a plain version bump: verified both are ESM with an identical `export default decompress(input, output, options)` signature, and shellcheck already passes its own plugins explicitly (decompressTarXz/decompressUnzip) rather than relying on decompress's bundled defaults, so this is a clean drop-in. Remove once shellcheck migrates off the abandoned package upstream.
